description: Per-Slurm-job host-side drill-down from cgroup_* and node_* on the trays. Formerly the Nemotron board; workload name is not exported by any live collector, so runs are chosen by job ID.

options.content:
Training-run drill-down — host CPU, memory and tray health. The Grace-side half of a run: cgroup CPU and RSS for the job's own control group, plus the tray's overall load and free memory. GPU compute for the same job is on Run Drill-Down · GPU Compute. Note: workload name is not exported by any live collector, so runs are selected by Slurm job ID rather than by model.

panels.title: Host footprint of the selected run

panels.description: Distinct trays carrying a step of the selected job(s).
panels.title: Trays used by the selected run(s)

panels.description: Sum of max_over_time(cgroup_memory_rss_bytes[$__range]) across the job's control groups.
panels.title: Peak resident memory held by the run's cgroups

panels.description: Sum over the selected job's control groups of cgroup_cpu_total_seconds rate averaged across 15 minutes, i.e. total host cores busy. The 'CPU cores' column in the table to the right is built from the identical expression and sums to this number.

targets.expr: sum(rate(cgroup_cpu_total_seconds[15m]) * on(node,cgroup) group_left(jobid) max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: CPU cores busy across the run (15 m mean)

panels.description: Peak max_over_time(node_load1[$__range]) over the job's trays.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time(node_load1[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Highest 1-minute load reached on any tray in the run

panels.description: Every tray carrying a step of the selected job(s). Footer Count equals the tray stat, the CPU cores column sums to the CPU stat and the first load1 row is the load stat — all built from the identical selectors.
panels.title: Trays in the selected job(s) — the exact trays (footer Count = the tray stat; 'CPU cores' sums to the CPU stat; top load1 row = the load stat)

defaults.noValue: No job control group is reporting resident memory.

panels.title: Job cgroups by resident memory — these rows sum to the RSS stat above
Memory pressure on the job's trays

panels.description: Trays in the selected job whose max_over_time(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes[$__range]) has fallen below 64 GiB.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes[$__range]) < 68719476736 and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Run trays that dropped under 64 GiB available

panels.description: max_over_time(cgroup_memory_fail_count[$__range]) > 0 — the kernel has refused an allocation to this job at least once.
panels.title: Run control groups that hit their memory limit

panels.description: Worst-case free memory across the job's trays.

targets.expr: min(max_over_time(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)
